update_law.burst_detection: contiguous gradient_total_norm > clip_threshold intervals, merging sub-bursts separated by at most 50 optimizer steps; major bursts have peak norm at least 10 times the clip threshold
update_law.burst_recurrence: period_next = clamp(period + period_delta, 150, 650); center_next = center + period_next; period_delta_next = 0.5 * period_delta
update_law.formation_condition: prefix validation state determines how many observed-state burst cycles remain; the transition is the first 100-step evaluation after the last required cycle
update_law.curve_law: log-odds progress from current prefix validation accuracy to 0.95 at the state-predicted transition, followed by a bounded burst-hazard decrement
update_law.stability_law: post-formation margin reserve grows during quiescent full-batch updates and is transiently reduced around predicted clipped-burst intervals

structural_inputs: capability evaluations and their exact parameter binding
materialized validation logits and validation targets at the prefix cut
current AdamW first- and second-moment tensors
cross_run_scope: Constants are discovery-estimated; all location, phase, margin, recurrence period and optimizer tension are re-initialized from the unseen prefix. No run identity or fixed transition step is used.
uncertainty: The 200-step and 500-step intervals encode within-run replay error. Burst-risk windows widen with optimizer tension and forecast horizon because one discovery execution cannot establish exact cross-run pulse timing.
